name: Hiyoko Kindergarten
description: Hiyoko Kindergarten — a kindergarten and nursery theme laid out as a card mosaic: under a formal top header (kindergarten name, tagline and a Book a visit button), the menu leaves the bar on wide screens and becomes a fixed bark-ink side rail down the left edge with numbered entries (in Japanese the entries run top to bottom). Dandelion yellow (#FFD900) is the main colour: the hero, the story band and every page head are yellow fields set in bark ink, with a faint paper grain. The hero is a cut-out object breaking its frame: the title, lead and buttons on the left, an ink-framed photograph of a bright classroom on the right, and a cut-out yellow backpack (transparent WebP) sitting over the frame's corner, half inside and half out, dropping past the hero bottom edge; cut-out wooden blocks break over the story band and every page head. The four classes sit in a rounded card mosaic. Every picture is a realistic 35mm film-grain photograph of a modern, international kindergarten. M PLUS Rounded 1c for display, Fredoka for reading, Noto Sans TC for Traditional Chinese headings. Sample content in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German; vertical labels only in Chinese and Japanese. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.
deviation: Illustration only: the plan row says woodblock, and the 2026-10-18 image rule turns every new commercial theme to realistic photographs, so woodblock became the film-grain photo direction (35mm, 50mm f/2, natural side light, visible grain, slightly faded, graded toward dandelion #FFD900), the closest in its flat, grainy, printed feel. Everything else is built exactly to design-plan.json row b5-2 (card-mosaic, cutout-break-frame-object hero, side-rail nav, cutout-break-frame, dandelion #FFD900, M PLUS Rounded 1c + Fredoka, education-classes). Break-frame: the cut-out backpack breaks out of the framed hero photo and the hero bottom edge; cut-out wooden blocks break over the story band and page heads.

summary.en: A dandelion-yellow kindergarten: card mosaic, fixed side-rail menu, a cut-out backpack breaking its frame, film-grain photos.
summary.ja: たんぽぽ色の幼稚園。カードのモザイク、左の固定レール、枠を越える黄色いリュック、35mmフィルム調の写真。
summary.fr: Une maternelle jaune pissenlit : mosaïque de cartes, menu en rail latéral, sac à dos détouré qui sort du cadre, photos argentiques.
